description:
List the workers you hired on one bounty, by when they applied, newest first, with where each one stands and who is on site. Each call reads one stretch of the applications, so a page can hold fewer rows than `limit`, or none, while `nextCursor` says more remain; keep going until a page has no `nextCursor`. Each hire is read when the list reaches it, so one that changes while you page is still listed once. An applicant you accept after the list has passed them is not in that walk; start again to see them.
Use for: seeing every worker on a bounty, their money and what waits for you.
Not for: reading one hire in full, with the work (get_hire); finding work that waits for review (list_submissions); reading who applied and is not hired (list_applications).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_hires({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","status":"active","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. Each call reads one stretch of the applications and builds at most `limit` hires from it, so a page can hold fewer rows than `limit`, or none, while `nextCursor` says more remain; only a page without `nextCursor` is the end.

status.description: Only hires in this status. Default: every hire.

name: list_hires

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks.

attendance.description: Where the worker is for this round of work. Read the detail with get_hire. Left out on a bounty that is not in person, or before they start sharing.

anyOf.description: Phone reports but position is old.
Updates pause while the app is in the background.

state.description: Only on_site and off_site establish a position relative to the site.

cost.description: What this hire costs you as its held money stands now: pay plus service fee. Left out when nothing is held: the fee of a pay-later hire is set when you pay.

at.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

paidAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

pay.description: The worker's pay for this hire, bonuses included: base pay plus the most the bonuses can pay until they are decided, then base pay plus the bonuses earned. Left out only when it cannot be read: every hire has pay.

payStatus.description: Where the money stands. paid means it was released to the worker and left your side for good; it does not say the worker's balance was credited yet.

status.description: offered: waiting for the worker to confirm. active: working, or fixing a redo. submitted: work waits for your review, or the work is done and its pay waits for you to release or pay it. paid: the pay was released to the worker. disputed: the money is held until the platform settles it. ended: the hire is over without pay, see endedReason.

worker.description: The hired worker. id or name is left out only on an older hire that did not store it.

title: List hires
